snippet.title: 하나만 골라도 대박 👏 명절에 맛있는 전 하나만 있으면 다른 요리가 필요 없습니다 !
snippet.description:
#고추전 #육전 #동태전 

 안녕하세요 ~^^
오늘은 다가오는 명절에 딱 좋은 맛있는 전 네 가지를 준비해봤습니다 😊
아삭아삭하면서 부드러운 감칠맛이 좋은 고추전,
하나하나 부치지 않고 간편하면서 푸짐하게 한판으로 부치는 육전,

손에 밀가루 묻히지 않고 깔끔하게 만드는 동태전,
이렇게 네 가지 중에서 하나만 골라도 명절에 폭풍칭찬 받습니다 👍


💕 '엄마의 요리백과' 밴드에 방문해보세요 🍀
https://band.us/band/92300370

대란 1알

-간장양념장
대파 15g
양조간장 2스푼
식초 1스푼
설탕 1/2스푼

돼지고기 다짐육 150g 
    ( + 진간장 1/2스푼, 설탕 1/2스푼, 다진마늘 1스푼, 참기름 1/2스푼 )
대파 60g
밀가루 6스푼
소금 1/2 티스푼
특란 1알

-양파초간장
양파 80g
청양고추 1개
진간장 2스푼
식초 1과1/2스푼
설탕 1스푼



             - 3. 육전 -

육전용 홍두깨살 400g ( + 미림, 소금, 후추 )
대파 60g
찹쌀가루 120g
대란 8알 ( + 소금 4꼬집 )

-초간장양파절임
진간장 2스푼
식초 1스푼
설탕 1스푼
양파 80g
홍청양고추 1개



            - 4. 동태전 -

동태포 420g
쪽파 15g
홍청양고추 1개
소금 2/3 티스푼
백후추 1/5 티스푼

en-US.description:
#Gochujeon #Yukjeon #Dongtaejeon

Hello ~^^
Today, I've prepared four delicious pancakes perfect for the upcoming holidays. 😊
Gochujeon, crunchy yet soft and savory;
Yukjeon, easy and filling, made in one batch instead of individually;
Mungbean Jeon, 10 times easier and tastier than mung bean pancakes;
Dongtaejeon, clean and easy to make without getting your hands dirty with flour;
Pick just one of these four and you'll be showered with holiday cheers! 👍

💕 Visit the 'Mom's Cooking Encyclopedia' band 🍀
https://band.us/band/92300370

--

* 1 tablespoon = 15ml, 1 teaspoon = 5ml. (For a regular rice spoon, 1 tablespoon is 9 to 12 ml.)

Ingredients

- 1. Gochujeon -

200g crispy peppers
1 red pepper
90g crab meat
7 perilla leaves (15g)
30g green onions
1/2 teaspoon salt (2g)

6 tablespoons pancake mix
1 large egg

- Soy sauce seasoning
15g green onions
2 tablespoons brewed soy sauce
1 tablespoon vinegar
1/2 tablespoon sugar

- 2. Aged kimchi and bijijeon -

150g aged kimchi
400g biji (bean curds) (Use low-moisture biji)
100g bean sprouts
150g minced pork

(+ 1/2 tablespoon soy sauce, 1/2 tablespoon sugar, minced garlic) 1 tablespoon, 1/2 tablespoon sesame oil)
60g green onion
6 tablespoons flour
1/2 teaspoon salt
1 large egg

- Onion and soy sauce
80g onion
1 Cheongyang pepper
2 tablespoons soy sauce
1 and 1/2 tablespoons vinegar
1 tablespoon sugar

- 3. Meat pancake

400g beef round meat (+ mirin, salt, pepper)
60g green onion
120g glutinous rice flour
8 large eggs (+ 4 pinches salt)

- Pickled onion in soy sauce
2 tablespoons soy sauce
1 tablespoon vinegar
1 tablespoon sugar
80g onion
1 red chili pepper

- 4. Pollack pancake

420g dried pollack
15g green onion
1 red chili pepper
Salt 2/3 teaspoon
1/5 teaspoon white pepper
1 teaspoon sesame oil
1 tablespoon cornstarch
1 tablespoon wheat flour
3 large eggs

en-US.title: If you make seaweed like this, it will be a fantastic taste that will bring back your appetite ev...
en-US.description:
#SeaweedCucumberSalt #SideDishes #Cucumber

Hello~^^
Today, I made a perfect menu for the increasingly hot weather, seaweed and cucumber salad. 😊
If you have one of these, everyone's taste buds will be captivated~^^

With a spicy, sour, and savory taste that you can't stop thinking about,
it's the best side dish that will bring back your appetite after leaving the house in the heat 👍

📣‼️ Come visit the 'Mom's Cooking Encyclopedia' band~^^
https://band.us/band/92300370

--

Ingredients

30g dried seaweed (+ 1 tbsp Cheongju)
70g cucumber (+ 1/2 tsp salt)
50g onion
1 green chili pepper
1/2 red chili pepper

2 tbsp gochujang
1 tsp fine chili powder
1 and 1/2 tbsp soy sauce
Salt 4 pinches
2 tablespoons of double vinegar
1 tablespoon of sugar
2/3 tablespoons of minced garlic
1 tablespoon of sesame seeds

* I used a measuring spoon of 15 ml for 1 tablespoon and 5 ml for 1 teaspoon.
(In the case of a regular rice spoon, 1 tablespoon is 9 ml to 12 ml.)
